question: Does K562 SRSF5 shRNA ENCORE KD%23.1/20.5 mean depletion or residual expression?
scope: Bounded primary-source audit; original selection/protocol/results unchanged.
reported_field: ENCORE KD% summary column; sample detail Rep1_WB/Rep2_WB and WB_result
assay: Western blot report; qPCR values are separately54.0 and58.3

exact_sample_attachment_search.available_exact_sample_pdfs: Library Preparation and Characterization Documents, not WB/qPCR biosample validation

related_primary_validation.caption_scope: Depletion-level analysis; bands decrease in KD samples. Supports the general depletion interpretation of the portal field, but does not directly define or reconstruct the old LV11 measurements.

related_primary_validation.sample: K562 SRSF5 CRISPR replacement, not original shRNA
related_primary_validation.caption_scope: Depletion-level analysis; marked reduction of the target band. Different perturbation method and sample batch, so not a direct validation of23.1/20.5.

interpretation: The label KD% and related same-lab validation examples favor reported depletion as the intended general convention. The original LV11 Western calculation and normalization are unavailable in retrieved primary evidence, so the exact23.1/20.5 percentages remain definition-unverified. Do not convert them to residual percentages or assert measured low protein knockdown as a confirmed mechanism.
recommended_wording: 官方ENCORE的WB/KD%字段为23.1和20.5；原LV11验证附件及计算定义未取得。ENCODE提交者注明该shRNA实验被敲低率更高的ENCSR528YVC取代。本轮保留数据并按预定计划报告SRSF5剔除敏感性。
correction_scope: Replace categorical low knockdown efficacy / only20-23%depletion claims with reported-field values plus validation-definition uncertainty and the explicit ENCODE supersession note.
